Saldean's Farm still yields vegetables while much of Westfall lies fallow under threat from Defias outlaws and rogue harvest golem attacks. Okra grows in the tilled plots around the farm. Ordanus' Head is the grisly trophy taken from Keeper Ordanus at Raynewood Retreat in Ashenvale. Claimed on behalf of the blood elf magi Braelyn Firehand, it serves as undeniable proof that one of Cenarius's eldest sons has fallen to arcane vengeance.

Keeper Ordanus was an ancient keeper of the grove, one of the elder scions of the forest god Cenarius. When Braelyn Firehand climbed the heights of Stonetalon Mountains on orders from her master, she sought to end the druids' stifling of magic at the peak and exact vengeance on Ordanus. However, the keeper was spirited away to the heart of Ashenvale before she could strike. Using arcane scrying to peer through the forest canopy, Firehand located his sanctuary in the boughs of Raynewood Retreat, demanding his severed head as proof that the wild demigod's arrogance had finally been answered.

Braelyn holds an old grievance against Ordanus, whom she knew long ago, and hates the druids who seek to stifle the flow of magic. In life, Ordanus considered himself superior even to the ancient Highborne nobility. By taking his head, Firehand symbolically strikes back against the legacy of Cenarius, declaring that no guardian of the wild can stem the return of raw magical power.
